rows.question: What system did Kestrel United start the match in, and did they change their system during it? When, to what, and why?
rows.answer: Kestrel United started the match in a 3-4-3 system in possession and a 4-3-3 system out of possession. At 6', while the score was 0-0, they switched to a 4-3-3 in possession with a deeper back line and slightly shorter defensive block. By 41', trailing 0-1, their defensive shape became a deeper and narrower 4-1-4-1. At 45+3', after equalising (1-1), they reverted their possession system to 3-4-3, widening their block. At 65', when behind 1-2, Kestrel United’s defensive shape changed again to 5-3-2 with a raised back line and wider block, and between 69'-71' this shifted further to a 5-3-1 with a deeper and more compact defensive line. The findings show timed changes between 3-4-3 and 4-3-3 in possession, and increasingly defensive shapes (4-1-4-1, then 5-3-2 and 5-3-1) out of possession as the match progressed.
